title: Qwen Code: Autonomous AI Coding Agent
summary: An open-source terminal-based AI agent and model family specialized for software engineering. It automates complex repository-level tasks like debugging, refactoring, and multimodal documentation analysis.
research_notes: Supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) and handles massive context windows up to 1 million tokens for large-scale codebases.

evolution.summary: Evolved from Qwen2.5-Coder into a full agentic ecosystem featuring 'Thinking Mode' for reasoning and native multimodal support for UI and diagram understanding.
